## Model selection defaults and project overrides

Governance now ships a provisional model-and-effort table for routine implementation, difficult
implementation, integration, diagnosis and review, deeper reasoning, and major planning.

Adopting projects can override individual rows or replace the table in tracked
`config/governance/model-selection.md`. Explicit task instructions take precedence. The coordinator
reads this Markdown policy, confirms host availability, and passes concrete choices to existing
native or harness controls. There is no automatic model router or silent fallback.

The installed planning and delegation guidance links to the shared policy. Skill refreshes preserve
project overrides. Existing provider connection configuration and runtime configuration schemas
are unchanged. Model recommendations remain provisional; this release makes no benchmark claims.
